hard_rule: AN IMAGE GENERATOR MAY CONTRIBUTE TO A PRODUCT AUTHORITY, BUT IT MAY NOT BE THE SOLE RENDERER OF PRECISION PRODUCT UI.

renderer.viewport_mapping: The 9:16 frame height equals the 852-pt JURNL mobile viewport height; the 393-pt viewport is the central 82.05% of the frame width (43-pt environment bleed each side — the same crop the runtime applies to 9:16 plates). All UI, text and data objects stay inside the central 82%; the side bleed carries environment only.

next_sprint_budget.rule: One scene plate per territory. Retry only on a failed generator QA, baked-UI or contamination check, or a data-geometry miss the assembly cannot re-cut; each retry logged with its reason.

method: Every deterministic zone (PRODUCT_ZONE_ROLES + SYSTEM_ZONE_ROLES + any slot with a precision kind) becomes a RESERVED REGION on the plate.
OCR the plate: any legible glyph anywhere → reject (plates carry no text).
Score each reserved region with the CENTER_STAGE salience method (0.55 × local edge energy + 0.30 × saturation + 0.15 × bright luminance); mean must stay ≤ the threshold.
Human check of every reserved region at 100 %: no button shapes, pills, nav cells, icon glyphs, logo-like marks, ghost labels.
baked_ui_guard.reserved_region_rule: A reserved region may carry material and light only (plaster, paper, stone, shadow) — the quiet surface the deterministic UI sits on.

reference_rule: The plate guide is the only reference. Never attach the official logo (the generator must not draw it), a value study or lock board, a previous candidate, or any other family’s image.
